search_queries: targeted PyPI and project-documentation lookups for nine named JSON parsers
uncertainty: Nine positive-signal Python JSON third-party paths pass valid nested object and array controls with source-level parser coverage and AFL++ feedback: pydantic 2.14.3 (1,139,429,690 PyPI Stats last-month downloads), jiter 0.19.0 (421,162,504), orjson 3.13.0 (218,014,317), simplejson 4.3.0 (49,365,386), ijson 3.6.0 (46,615,664), msgspec 0.22.0 (39,138,375), ujson 6.1.0 (29,543,889), python-rapidjson 1.26 (4,066,455), and pysimdjson 8.0.0 (679,340). Pydantic embeds Jiter 0.18.0; standalone jiter uses Jiter 0.19.0 through a distinct package API. These are shared-family paths, not independent parsers, and their package downloads are not combined; orjson shares the yyjson C syntax-parser family but this pilot measures its Rust deserializer, not vendored C source lines. ijson uses the asserted yajl2_c backend, with pinned YAJL C tokenizer and Python extension coverage; its source-built embedded YAJL -O0 route differs from the official Linux wheel linkage and optimisation, and its other backends are untested. msgspec uses its own C JSON decoder in _core.c through untyped msgspec.json.decode; its source-built clang -O0 path differs from the official GCC wheel, typed decoding is untested, and JSON decoder sections are counted separately from other codecs in the same file. ujson uses its own UltraJSON C decoder with vendored double-conversion C++ for fractional numbers; both controls equal an exact CPython json oracle tree, and duplicate-key and edge-number behavior is recorded from source, not tested. python-rapidjson parses a local BytesIO stream through rapidjson.load with vendored Tencent RapidJSON v1.1.0-763-g24b5e7a8, the same RapidJSON C++ family as the C++ RapidJSON path at a later revision; RapidJSON reader.h and the rapidjson.cpp wrapper are counted separately, and default number conversion bypasses RapidJSON strtod. PyPI package downloads include non-parse uses and transitive installs. All nine targeted documented leads have been checked; bounded PyPI Simple Index search has not yet been run. pysimdjson uses vendored simdjson 5.1.1 DOM and a generated Cython wrapper; native parser and wrapper source lines are reported separately. Python standard json is separately verified.
